items.definition: A letter sending you to another service, such as a specialist, a physiotherapist or a scan.
items.example: I have a referral for a scan, and the appointment is in ten days.

items.definition: A machine with two wheels that you push with your feet. A good bicycle makes your legs feel like they have a strong friend.
items.example: His grandfather's bicycle was heavy and rusty, and Nam loved it.

items.definition: The flat part of a bicycle that your foot stands on. When you push the pedals, the wheels turn.
items.example: The pedals were stiff, so he pushed them three times.

items.definition: The flat part that helps a bird to lift into the air. On this bicycle, the wings are only paper, but they still lift.
items.example: The newspaper wings lifted when he rang the bell.

items.definition: The small metal thing on a bicycle that makes a sound when you press it. Nam's bell is old and a bit tired.
items.example: He pressed the bell three times before the wings moved.

items.definition: The flat top of a building. In the old quarter, the rooftops are close enough to almost touch.
items.example: They landed on the roof garden above the old house.

items.definition: A big old building with thick walls, made to keep people safe. Castles usually have towers and gates.
items.example: From her window, Hà could see the castle on the hill.

items.definition: A tall round part of a castle. You can climb to the top of a tower and look out over everything.
items.example: The castle had one round tower with a flag on top.

items.definition: A small metal thing that opens a lock. A keyhole is the hole where the key goes in.
items.example: The small brass key hung on a red string.

items.definition: A piece of ground where people grow plants and flowers. A garden needs water and a little care every day.
items.example: The green door opened on a garden under a round moon.

items.definition: The small beginning of a plant. A seed is tiny and quiet, but if you plant it and water it, it grows.
items.example: In the clay pot there was a seed with a green shoot coming out.

items.definition: A machine that pushes itself up into the sky with fire and gas. It is how people reach space.
items.example: The rocket stood on the pad, white and tall.

items.definition: The platform where the rocket stands and waits before it flies.
items.example: Everybody watched from the launch pad.

items.definition: A person trained to fly into space. Astronauts wear a spacesuit because there is no air out there.
items.example: The astronaut opened the hatch and stepped out.

items.definition: The feeling of floating, with nothing pulling you down. Everything drifts in the ship.
items.example: In weightlessness, even a pencil can float.

items.definition: The path one space object follows as it goes around and around another one.
items.example: The Moon is in orbit around the Earth.

items.definition: The little home a bird builds out of twigs and grass. It is warm and it holds the eggs.
items.example: Wren's nest was in the apple tree.

items.definition: All the eggs that one bird lays in one nest, counted together.
items.example: The blackbird's clutch has five eggs in it.

items.definition: To keep eggs warm so that the chicks inside can grow. The parent bird does it by sitting on them.
items.example: The mother bird is incubating her eggs.

items.definition: To come out of an egg. A chick hatches by pushing the shell from the inside.
items.example: One chick hatched this morning, and it is still wet.

items.definition: An open grassland with trees scattered here and there, between a forest and a desert.
items.example: The savanna is a wide field of grass with a few acacia trees.

items.definition: An animal that eats plants, such as a zebra, a giraffe or an elephant.
items.example: The elephant is a herbivore, so it eats grass and leaves.

items.definition: An animal that eats other animals. Carnivores are often the strong, heavy ones.
items.example: The heavy animal with the thick tail was a carnivore.

items.definition: A long journey that animals make every year to follow the rain and the new grass.
items.example: The wildebeest migration crosses the whole savanna.

items.definition: An animal that lives with people, like a dog, a cat or a fish.
items.example: My dog is a pet. He sleeps on my bed.

items.definition: An animal that lives on its own in nature, not with people.
items.example: A tiger is a wild animal. We must keep far away from it.

items.definition: An animal that people keep on a farm to help them, like a cow or a chicken.
items.example: My uncle has a farm with cows and chickens.

items.definition: The place where an animal lives, with the food, water and shelter it needs there.
items.example: The reef is the habitat of the clownfish and the small fish.

items.definition: An animal that is in danger of disappearing for ever, because there are so few left.
items.example: The giant panda is endangered. We must protect it.

items.definition: The word for your mother. Some families say mom or mommy instead.
items.example: My mum is a nurse. She works at a hospital.

items.definition: Your mum's mother or your dad's mother. You often call her grandma.
items.example: My grandmother grows vegetables in the garden.

items.definition: Your mum's sister, or the wife of your uncle. Sometimes a family friend is called an aunt too.
items.example: My aunt lives in Da Nang.

items.definition: A child of your aunt or your uncle. A cousin is like a brother or sister, but not a real one.
items.example: My cousin Mai is my age. We play together every weekend.

items.definition: The word for your mum and your dad together.
items.example: My parents work at the weekend too.

items.definition: The polite word you say before you ask for something. It shows you are asking, not taking.
items.example: Please, can I have the blue cup?

items.definition: A question asking if you are allowed to have something. The person can answer yes or no.
items.example: Can I have a piece of bread?

items.definition: A softer way to ask, good for when you talk to somebody you do not know well.
items.example: Could I have the menu, please?

items.definition: A warm way to say what you want. It is like saying I want, but kinder.
items.example: I would like some orange juice, please.

items.definition: A medical reaction to a food, which can be dangerous. It must be told to the staff as an allergy, not as a dislike.
items.example: I have a shellfish allergy. Is this dish safe for me?

items.definition: The sun is shining and there are few clouds. A sunny day is a happy day.
items.example: It is sunny, so we can play outside.
